title: [Advanced Paste] Show AI compliance notice when Paste with AI is enabled

proposed_comments.body:
### Correct the responsibility dialog's wording

**Severity:** `low`

The dialog displays "AI agents and models ... is your choice," although the subject is plural. Please use "are" and match the neighboring paragraph's "third-party" hyphenation. This keeps the responsibility notice's meaning and product-name placeholder unchanged.

```suggestion
    <value>AI agents and models that you host and choose to connect to are your choice. If you choose a third-party agent or model, Microsoft may not provide, host, operate, or monitor them. If you use {0} to interact with an agent or model you host, you do so at your own risk.</value>
```

confidence.rationale: The changed English resource contains a directly observable plural subject/verb mismatch; the adjacent paragraph establishes third-party hyphenation.

proposed_comments.title: Correct the responsibility dialog wording
